sentences.text: South Australia’s outgoing Independent Commissioner Against Corruption reviewed seven years of the office’s work and proposed legislative reforms.
sentences.support: Because this is my last report I will reflect upon my last seven years as Commissioner

sentences.text: The Commissioner described investigation, complaint oversight, agency evaluation and education as parts of the office’s broader integrity role.
sentences.support: In reality the investigation of corruption is but one of around 20 functions given to the office

sentences.text: The Commissioner concluded that corruption was present but not systemic, while widespread maladministration created opportunities for corrupt conduct.
sentences.support:
Corruption exists in South Australia but South Australia does not have a corrupt public 
administration.

sentences.text: The Commissioner recommended a public integrity commission and changes to statutory definitions and investigation powers.
sentences.support:
Perhaps most fundamentally I recommend that the name of the office is changed and that South 
Australia move to the establishment of a public integrity commission.

findings.quote:
Corruption exists in South Australia but South Australia does not have a corrupt public 
administration.

There is however 
evidence of widespread maladministration which enables individuals to engage in corrupt 
conduct.

notes: No separate executive summary or equivalent synopsis is provided. Legislative proposals are discussed across thematic sections without a numbered recommendations list.
